brief:
Fadi Murad, a Palestinian artist, is presenting "Come Back Home," an unconventional drama at Summerhall in Edinburgh, The Guardian reported. The production employs a collage structure shaped by poetic free-form imagination to explore themes of loss and love through an intriguing fringe hour performance.

The work follows from a broader cultural initiative launched by Scottish producers last year. That venture, a four-day mini festival called Welcome to the Fringe, Palestine, showcased excerpts from Palestinian artists' productions, creating a platform for emerging work from the region during the Edinburgh Fringe season.
